name: Alboloduy (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist, green above and red below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alboloduy (a castle, a bell tower and a lion).
history: The flag is described as a cloth of 2:3 composed of two equal triangles, the upper green and the lower red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms; the colours were taken from the arms so as not to suggest the flag of another municipality (BOJA no. 84 of 30 April 2004).

features.role: Alboloduy arms — castle, bell tower and lion
